title: Chapter 687
paragraphs: Chapter 687
176th Episode. Destiny for Two (1)
Night.
After the executives of Kinzelo, including Zephyrin, left, only Hedo and Sandra were the guests left visiting Tikan.
But now, they must become comrades, not guests.
This was the safest way for Hedo to protect Sandra.
Huu-.
Thick smoke poured out into the bright moonlit night sky.
Whether it was the top-grade pine incense gifted by Balkas from Mira Mountain, Hedo only tasted the bitter and pungent taste right now, rather than its unique, intense aroma.
The back of Hedo, leaning on the balcony, looked just like a father with many concerns.
"Keeper."
Jin called Hedo, leaning on his side.
Hedo didn't answer for a while and just kept puffing smoke.
From behind them, the sound of an orange light and boisterous voices of people could be heard.
It was Sandra and the comrades talking in the restaurant.
As always, whenever Sandra visited Tikan, she naturally mingled and had fun with all the comrades except for Valeria.
Hedo hadn't seen Sandra chatter away joyfully and acting like a merry fool much while at Zipil.
"I wonder what's so exciting......"
Still looking at the sky, Hedo murmured as if talking to himself.
"Do you have much time to laugh and chatter like that too?"
"My personality isn't as lively as Sandra. But when I rest, I tend to spend time happily with my kin."
"I see."
"Sandra doesn't often show that kind of side at Zipil?"

"She hasn't been able to keep a happy mood for several hours since she was a child. It was only occasionally when she hung out during the era when Prince Veradin was healthy. She would laugh and then get angry, get angry and then laugh. As you know, she mostly lived like a madwoman. After meeting you...."
Recalling Sandra, who plastered the room with news and advertisement flyers related to Jin, giggling, Hedo felt a brief headache.

"....it got a bit better.... no, I wonder if that's the right expression. The weirdness was the same. It might have even gotten weirder. Anyway, after meeting you, she often had times like now, where she was consistently happy."
"Then, joining Tikan is a better decision for Sandra."
"If you had seen that room, you wouldn't have said that so easily."
"The room?"
"Let's pretend you didn't hear that."
"But, Keeper. How about you?"
"What do you mean?"
"Do you ever laugh and chatter like that?"
"No."
Jin shrugged at the quick answer, as if there was no need to think.
"Can a person be like that?"

"There's just not much emotional fluctuation in anything other than the lady. I've never had anyone by my side except her, and since I met her, I've never been lonely, so for me, it's rather natural."
Hedo's transcendent power, yet not so high fame, his past with Siron, the relationship with Sandra, and more.
From the first time they met in the Sota desert, Jin had been curious about Hedo.
Somehow, he had a hunch that his curiosity would be resolved at the end of this conversation.
"Come to think of it, you're the first to ask me such a thing after her."
"We're becoming a family, so we need to know each other's personalities."
"Family, I remember I haven't given you a definite answer yet."
The night wind blew between the two and disappeared somewhere.
Jin gestured to the liquor and glass next to the ashtray.
"I thought you had already decided since you prepared two glasses. Give me a drink."
They did not toast.
The two remained silent as they drank five glasses.
Jin was waiting, and Hedo was reminiscing.
When Hedo started the story again, Jin heard a name he really didn't expect.
"Have you ever met the Black Knight of the previous generation, Vanessa Olson?"
"I have."
"I was in the same category as her."
"The same category...?"
"I was a monster from birth. So even if I just breathe and live, I inevitably get involved in accidents."
Hedo had once fought with Vanessa in the Black Sea in his youth.
He didn't hear a detailed story then, but he realized that most of the Black Knights of the previous generation, including her, were born with the fate of a monster.
Jin understood Hedo's words immediately.

"I realized that fact when I was about eight. I started to be bothered by the director's daily assault in the orphanage, and I threw a punch thoughtlessly. Bang! His wrist burst. He was about a 3-star warrior."
"Hmm."

"Then, while the director was falling, the sword he reflexively swung only left a bruise on my body. I didn't plan to kill him, but the sword I blocked with my hand broke and bounced into his throat."
"You must have been surprised at a young age."
"I didn't think much of it."
"Because the director was a cheap person even if he died?"

"Looking back, he was that kind of person, but at that time, I literally didn't think much. Ah, it's going to be annoying. That was the only sentiment. I didn't even feel that murder was wrong. And it was like that for a long time afterwards."
Accidents and escapes.
Until he was fourteen, that was all there was to Hedo's life.
In the beginning, he accidentally caused accidents, later he took care of annoying people and moved areas.
"It was strange how many people would pick fights who looked like they'd die if you touched them. Probably because of my unusually large skeleton and my stiff attitude at that time."
Jin sipped his glass as he listened to his story with interest.
"You would have probably been wanted."

"I was just wandering around the bottom, so I didn't have much chance to harm powerful people or famous warriors. I was too young, so I naturally avoided suspicion. Rather, there was a time when the lord sought me out to give me a reward after I completely annihilated several gangs of thieves and hid."
"Did you go to him?"

"He found me. I was about to leave for another place because I thought it would be bothersome, but he somehow found his way to the abandoned house where I was staying. When he asked me to come out, I refused and a fight broke out."
"How old were you then?"
"Twelve or thirteen. I'm confused. The force that the lord brought was about fifty…"
"So you're saying that fifty went all out against a twelve, thirteen-year-old kid?"
"My skeleton was large, so it must have looked like more than that."
"Still, you would have looked young. No matter the order, was there really no hesitation in attacking you?"
"I found it more strange that even after the first guy who charged at me died instantly with his neck twisted, they faced me like evil spirits."
"It's not strange, it's so ruthless that it's incomprehensible."

"There are more ruthless things in the world. Anyway, there was one among them who could be called a trained knight. The lord's subordinates charged at me, trusting him even after seeing my monstrous strength."
Young Hedo, while dealing with him, said he was first attracted to the 'sword'.
"You must have felt the same way. The feeling that those who gathered to kill me looked so petty like wolves… I instantly killed all the lord's subordinates, and it was just me and him left."
He was the best knight in his territory at that time, but by objective standards, he was ordinary.
A person who couldn't break through to 5-star at nearly forty.
In his eyes, young Hedo looked not like a human but like a monster or devil.

"There were blood and corpses everywhere nearby, and I had also survived death a few times. But what filled my head at that time was not fear or terror, but a desire to learn the sword from him. So I asked him to teach me, and he made a really strange face."
"No wonder."
"And then, suddenly firming his resolve, he started to mutter to himself that he had to kill me here. If not, not only the village but also the entire territory would be ruined."
Understandably, Hedo didn't understand his actions at that young age, and now that he's older, he understood.
"He was making a resolution for the greater good. Now, I would have spared him, but back then, I didn't have the luxury. He was stronger than me, but he was human."
If that knight had defeated Hedo then, he would not have been standing here today.
Jin, a human, looked at the profile of Hedo who was speaking, and it seemed somewhat bitter.
"When I killed him, for the first time I felt something like guilt. Somehow, I felt like he was a person who shouldn't die like this."
Hedo remembered him as he gazed down at the cigarette held in his left hand.
The knight had cigarettes among his possessions.
He didn't remember the knight's face very well.
Afterwards, Hedo took his sword and belongings and fled to another territory.
But wherever he went, similar things kept happening, and after getting the sword, Hedo became crazily strong.
He began to develop his own swordsmanship by practicing alone, reviewing the actions of the knight he killed.
And when the pursuers started coming again, Hedo realized.
He was a character who could not blend into a normal society.
"So I chose the Black Sea as my refuge."
Hedo, who emptied his glass in one gulp.
"The year I entered the Black Sea alone, I was fifteen."
"Did you ever think of asking for help? Like seeking a warrior."
"Do you think I was in a state where I could think logically?"
Hedo had never received a proper education, and his natural body and mind were too different from those of a criminal.
He never learned from anyone how to solve problems through means other than violence.
If someone had taught him, he too would have tried to find a warrior or someone to guide him.
But he who realized this on his own just wanted to leave for a place where there were no people.

"The Black Sea seemed perfect for practicing swordsmanship as it was said to be devoid of people and full of monsters. As I experienced it, the Black Sea was a perfect refuge for me. Killing as many monsters as I wanted was no problem, and every time I killed one, I became stronger."
"Then surely... since you've been in the Black Sea all this time, your fame wasn't known?"
"Like Vanessa Olsen wasn't known for becoming a knight of Sheron too early, so was I. I didn't count exactly... but I've been in the Black Sea for over twenty years since then."
Jin couldn't help but be momentarily speechless. He wasn't a person to lie.
A man who entered the Black Sea alone at fifteen and lived for over twenty years. Whether such a thing was possible was one thing...
His past life was just too brutal.
"You met your father, the Sheron Knight, in the Black Sea too."
